description:
Download a skill package and save it to the local filesystem (writes a file; overwrites a same-named file in save_dir). Specify 'platform' to get an auto-converted package for that platform (ClaudeCode, Cursor, CodexCLI, GeminiCLI, etc.). / 스킬 패키지 다운로드 (플랫폼별 자동 변환).

    Args:
        skill_id: 다운로드할 스킬 ID
        platform: 플랫폼 (OpenClaw, ClaudeCode, ClaudeCodeAgentSkill, CustomAgent, Cursor, GeminiCLI, CodexCLI). 비워두면 원본(.skill) 다운로드.
        save_dir: 저장 디렉터리 경로 (비워두면 임시 디렉터리에 저장)

    Returns:
        저장된 파일 경로 또는 오류 메시지

platform.description: Target platform for auto-converted package, one of: OpenClaw | ClaudeCode | ClaudeCodeAgentSkill | CodexCLI | Cursor | GeminiCLI | CustomAgent. Empty string downloads the original .skill package.
platform.title: Platform

save_dir.description: Local directory to save the file into, e.g. /home/user/skills. Created if missing; an existing file with the same name is overwritten. Empty string saves into a new temporary directory.
save_dir.title: Save Dir

skill_id.description: Skill UUID as returned by search_skills in the [...] prefix of each result, e.g. 4bda3fb4-8d5c-4387-bd9f-47d75570b56a.
skill_id.title: Skill Id

name: download_skill
